title: stage_place_instance MCP tool missing creation-time visual properties
description: packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts stage_place_instance schema (lines ~394-409) only accepts symbolId, x, y, name, layerId, frameIndex. SymbolInstance model supports scaleX, scaleY, rotation, blendMode, filters, colorEffect, loopMode, clipActions — none reachable via stage_place_instance. Agents must follow with separate stage_update calls. Fix: extend the MCP schema to accept these optional fields and pass them through to the createSymbolInstance call.
